events.name: Edwardian Farm
events.description: Alex Langlands and Peter Ginn set sail in an Edwardian trawler for a fishing trip, but as women were considered bad luck at sea, Ruth Goodman is left ashore to forage on the beach, prepare potted shrimp and build a smoke-house to cure mackerel. She also explores one of the growing fashions of the era by holding a seance, while once back on dry land, Alex and Peter drive their cattle along a dangerous route to find a new pasture

Miles from the nearest road, the challenge of how to transport him to a hospital is a dilemma for team leader John

Miles from the nearest road, the challenge of how to transport him to a hospital is a dilemma for team leader John

To recognise his bravery, Alan and the team surprise the whole Rendall family and turn their featureless plot into an automobile-inspired haven
